name: Kafolat
tagline: An insurance broker: we find the right policy, explain the terms and help when you need to claim
niche: Insurance: motor liability, comprehensive car, property, health and travel

listing.description: A website for an insurer, broker or financial service. A friendly look, a shield that fills with colour, a tabbed policy picker and steps shown as a chat.

seo.title: Kafolat — insurance broker in Tashkent: car, home, travel
seo.description: We compare insurers’ offers and arrange motor liability, comprehensive car, home, health and travel cover. Online in 10 minutes, with help when you claim.
seo.answer: Kafolat is an insurance broker in Tashkent: we compare terms from several insurers and arrange the policy online or at our office at 22 Bobur Street. Motor liability is at the insurer’s tariff, comprehensive car cover from 2,400,000 UZS a year, home insurance from 300,000 UZS and a travel policy from 90,000 UZS. When you claim, we help gather the documents and follow the payout through.

sections.title: Insurance without the small print
sections.subtitle: We compare insurers’ offers, explain the terms in plain words and arrange your policy in 10 minutes. And if something happens, we stay with you until the payout.

sections.label: Policies
sections.title: What would you like to protect?
sections.intro: Prices are a guide. We calculate the exact cost with several insurers based on your details.

items.title: Car
items.text: Motor liability online and comprehensive cover against theft, accidents and natural events. We’ll help you choose the excess.

items.title: Home
items.text: Your renovation, belongings and liability to neighbours — whether you flood them or they flood you.

items.title: Health
items.text: Private medical cover: appointments, tests and inpatient care.

items.title: Travel
items.text: A policy for your visa and trip: medical, baggage and cancellation.

items.title: Business
items.text: Property, warehouse stock and company liability.

items.title: Life & family
items.text: Accident cover for adults and children.

items.title: Tell us what to insure
items.text: A car, a flat or a trip — plus a couple of details.

items.title: Here are three options
items.text: We compare insurers and explain the difference like a human.

items.title: I’ll take the second
items.text: Pay by card, Payme or Click.

items.title: Your policy is in Telegram
items.text: The e-policy arrives at once; a paper original on request.

items.quote: Our upstairs neighbours flooded our new renovation. Kafolat gathered the paperwork for me and I was paid in three weeks.
items.author: Malika

items.quote: They explained three comprehensive policies so clearly that for the first time I understood what I was paying for.
items.author: Timur

items.quote: They sorted my visa policy in one evening on Telegram — I didn’t have to go anywhere.
items.author: Sevara

items.q: Why isn’t a broker more expensive?
items.a: The insurer pays us, so your price is the same as going direct, but you get a wider choice.

items.q: What do I do when something happens?
items.a: Call or message the helpline: we’ll tell you which documents to gather and stay with you until the payout.
Yes, electronic motor and other policies are verified against the insurer’s database.

items.q: Can I get a refund on a policy?
items.a: Yes, on early cancellation part of the premium is returned under the insurer’s rules — we’ll help you apply.

sections.label: Contact
sections.title: Message us — we’ll find a policy today
sections.text: We reply on Telegram within 15 minutes during working hours.
